prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a naga sorceress: a slender humanoid upper body with dark plum-purple scales and a pale gold belly, gold armbands and a jewelled gold collar, a tall cobra-hood headdress of gold and dark plum framing her stern face with green eyes, two arms, holding one tall gold staff topped with a green jewel upright in the hand on the left side of the image (the far hand, behind her) in every cell, no legs: below the waist a long dark plum-purple serpent tail coiled on the ground; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides, the staff top well below the top of the grey box. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: her stern face with green eyes under the cobra-hood headdress is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, leaning forward over the coils toward the heroes, the free hand thrust forward with the fingers spread and the elbow bent, the staff held upright in the same hand as in the idle cell, the green jewel glowing, both hands well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back over the coils, the head tilted back, the free hand flung up, the staff upright in the same hand, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Lean and twist the upper body above the coils along a clear diagonal, bend the elbows and keep the staff upright and close to the body, so every part stays well inside its own cell; tighten or loosen the coils; the tail tip stays on the ground beside the coils. Draw only the parts named in the description: no cape, no spell effects, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, a humanoid upper body on a serpent tail, no legs: coiled upright inside the box, the lowest coil resting on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, legs, a trident, a sword, snake hair, fins, wings, blue scales, green scales, bright violet, pink, spell effects, a staff in each hand.
